description: Java class implementing an adapter for MessageCommandResponse objects, mapping them to and from an Adaptable representation within the Eclipse Ditto protocol framework.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: Final class that adapts MessageCommandResponse objects to and from an Adaptable, specific to handling command response messages within the Ditto protocol.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of MessageCommandResponseAdapter with a given HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a MessageCommandResponse object into an Adaptable, defaulting to the LIVE channel.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is for response messages, returning true.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter requires a subject, returning true.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the message type based on the Adaptable's topic subject and payload feature ID.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a MessageCommandResponse signal to an Adaptable using the SignalMapper.
